This '''unidentified individual''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who raced using a [[Vokoff-Strood/Legends|Vokoff-Strood]] podracer, residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="Target">''[[Rebel Force: Target]]''</ref>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the pilot was among the five podracers who raced against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who ultimately won the [[Muunilinst Podrace|race]] on the outskirts of [[Pilaan]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Muunilinst.<ref name="Target" />
